note.question: What determines organ wastage in a queueing-theoretic framework?
note.overview: Despite efforts to increase the supply of donated organs for transplantation, organ shortages persist. This paper studies the problem of organ wastage in a queueing-theoretic framework. We establish that self-interested individuals set their utilization levels more conservatively in equilibrium than the socially efficient level.
